p = 'src/index.js'
s = open(p).read()
old = "    const v = row[column];\n    if (v === '') continue;\n"
new = "    if (row[column] === '') continue;\n    const v = Number(row[column]);\n"
assert s.count(old) == 1
open(p, 'w').write(s.replace(old, new))
EOF
